source_quotes: we don't auto sync with p2p we notify and allow others to act via gate
announcements go through marketplace because we won't announce to each user 1x1
we don't accept anything not allowed
overlap_check: method_50 (30050) says agents act through the living network; method_48 covers MCP port registration. No EU methodology covers the marketplace. New.

payload.name: Peer Marketplace Notifies and Gates
payload.description: Findings reach other instances only as manifests announced once through the marketplace to approved peers. The receiver classifies and decides through its own gate. Nothing is applied automatically and blueprints are never shared.

principles.name: Notify, never auto-apply
principles.description: A peer's announcement is information; acting on it is the receiver's choice through a gate.

principles.name: Paired devices and peers are different
principles.description: Paired devices sync natively; the marketplace is a separate gated path and gets its own care.

heuristics.action: check which meaning of pairing is meant: the approved-peer list here, not device pairing

heuristics.condition: something is announced that nobody asked for
heuristics.action: check the allow-list and the privacy exclusions before sending

decision_rules.name: Announce manifests once
decision_rules.condition: a methodology, tool, pipeline or jurisdiction finding is created
decision_rules.outcome: announce its manifest (name and hash) through the marketplace in one push to connected approved peers, never one message per peer

decision_rules.name: Never share blueprints
decision_rules.condition: an item is about to be announced
decision_rules.outcome: exclude blueprints and exclude ingest or bookkeeping nodes that were not meant to leave the instance

decision_rules.name: Accept only what is allowed
decision_rules.outcome: accept it only from an operator-approved peer and only for a kind the operator allows

decision_rules.name: Classify locally before the gate
decision_rules.outcome: classify it against local data as have, conflict, same name, new or not checked, and show that classification at the gate

decision_rules.name: Apply only through the gate
decision_rules.condition: an operator or rule is deciding on an incoming item
decision_rules.outcome: download and apply only after the gate allows it and the item has been reviewed; never sync automatically

decision_rules.name: Publish findings, not offers
decision_rules.condition: a gap was filled by creating something
decision_rules.outcome: publish the created finding; do not use offers to fill gaps
